authorization.decision: Pivot the available 2x RTX A6000 host from blocked Q38 harvesting to a bounded Qwen3.5-2B endogenous self-bootstrapping foundation.

hypothesis: The same frozen 2B weights with a bounded inference-time search budget can produce verified successes on fresh causal tasks where a single deployment-scale attempt fails, and those P-plus-only successes can be compressed into separate orchestrator and child rank-16 LoRA adapters.

p_plus.description: compute-privileged best-of-four search using identical frozen weights

selection.p_success: the single rollout is complete, error-free, and hard-successful
selection.p_plus_success: at least one of four independently seeded rollouts is complete, error-free, and hard-successful
selection.compute_gap: P fails and P+ succeeds for the same task key

corpus.sources: complete hard-successful P+ trajectories from the preregistered discovery bank
corpus.orchestrator: sampled assistant spans from primary graph sessions only
corpus.child: sampled assistant spans from non-primary graph sessions only

stop_conditions: P-plus produces fewer than four verified compute-gap task keys
fewer than four complete lineage-valid trajectories exist for either role
the untouched 2B runtime is not infrastructure-stable
role routing cannot be evaluated without changing frozen task or verifier semantics
the first bounded compression dose fails to improve held-out P without unacceptable regression
